Crossref metadata for DOI 10.1007/s002330010100 confirmed the same title, author, journal, volume, issue, and pages, and exposed Springer TDM links for PDF and HTML fulltext. These links were only candidate full-text locators, not extraction evidence.

Springer DOI, article, fulltext, and PDF candidate URLs could not be resolved to a readable primary source artifact in the current environment; direct Springer fetches failed or returned access/cookie flow rather than usable full text.
OpenAlex matched the same DOI and title but reported is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false.
Unpaywall matched DOI 10.1007/s002330010100 but reported is_oa=false, has_repository_copy=false, and an empty oa_locations list.

Exact-work searches inspected candidate leads for the exact title, DOI, and author. The Szendrei bibliography page exposed only a citation list; Math Stack Exchange was a different forum source; arastirmax/EJPAM, Acta, and TU Darmstadt candidates only cited the article inside other works. No candidate was accepted because none provided readable full text of the exact source.
